body.opens: What can be downloaded by appropriate means and brought in as pure mechanics enters one's own field; rights return only when it is shared onward. Rendering from the source at read time needs no copy, caching is ordinary, and only a copy that stands in for a work needs its author.

name: A line of hygiene for data

body.opens: A feed is a file polled, a relay polls it for many, and the holder tracks no one; glass's store is already this shape, one line of a ref polled and only new packs fetched. Relays are stores, checked by the hash of each commit, and may follow relays.
Feeds and common media brought in as holons down to the word, read across sources by locality and shared words, arranged as compositions and layers, with analysis drawn and never stored.

name: A browser that reads in holons

body.opens: Keeping is all one already holds, by export as one's own; discovering is a social medium with no network to join, each field published as a website and connection opt-in. To elevate someone is to give them the means, or to build an offer they may take; never to publish a glass as them before they say yes.
restsOn: publishing a field as a website
